anatomy.treatment: Semibold label aligned with the object value; preserve a clear leading edge.

anatomy.role: Compare the main value with its unit
anatomy.treatment: Tabular numerals, aligned decimal positions, subdued but adjacent units.

anatomy.role: Show qualification and uncertainty before action
anatomy.treatment: Readable secondary type with explicit missing-value markers; never a decorative badge alone.
A restrained text action with a distinct focus outline.

visual_treatment.surface: Distinct table plane against the application canvas; the header is slightly more saturated than ordinary rows.
visual_treatment.edges: Quiet row separators; stronger group boundaries; outer curvature shares the surrounding panel family.
visual_treatment.elevation: Retain the project's layered panel depth; reserve a stronger shadow for an open detail overlay.
visual_treatment.typography: Semibold object labels, tabular comparison numerals, readable regular conditions, smaller adjacent units.
visual_treatment.spacing: Row rhythm is compact but consistent; inset alignment is shared by header and cells, with more space between attribute groups than between a value and its unit.
visual_treatment.color: Action, selected row, uncertain condition and quantitative emphasis use separate project color roles; avoid painting every row with the brand accent.
visual_treatment.imagery: Only target-owned object identifiers when they improve scanning; do not insert promotional artwork into comparison cells.
visual_treatment.motion: Brief selection feedback without geometry shifts; expanding detail preserves reading position and respects reduced motion.

preserve_character: Keep confident numerical hierarchy and the target's deliberate surface depth; do not bleach all distinctions to paper-neutral panels.
coherence_rules: Use the same type roles, corner family, focus treatment and depth ladder as the surrounding product, not an unrelated card kit.

responsive_variants.composition: Retain aligned comparison attributes in a bounded scroll region with persistent identity; put secondary provenance behind an explicit accessible action.
responsive_variants.access_path: Keyboard-reachable detail action opens provenance and returns focus to the same row.

responsive_variants.composition: Keep header and row alignment; wrap conditions while retaining value alignment and an explicit detail action.
responsive_variants.access_path: Inline detail action; no hover-only access.

responsive_variants.composition: Expose all comparison columns and group boundaries on one plane with stable numeric alignment.
responsive_variants.access_path: Inline pointer and keyboard actions preserve row context.

interaction_states.rest: Readable row divisions without making every row a floating card.
interaction_states.hover: Subtle row-plane tint without shifting text or becoming the only action cue.
interaction_states.focus-visible: Unclipped high-contrast outline on the exact focused control.
interaction_states.active: Persistent selected-row treatment distinguishable from transient hover.
interaction_states.disabled: Explain why the action is unavailable while retaining readable value and evidence text.

content_stress: Mixed digits, decimal values and units
Empty results and failed detail loads
intermediate_width_behavior: Test widths between named viewports and text zoom; wrap conditions before any primary comparison attribute is obscured. Never shrink desktop text to make the table fit.
